title: Chinlone
description: The cane-ball circle dance of Myanmar, with six dancers in 3D. You lead the dance: tap the named touch (inside foot, knee, back-heel, neck roll, shoulder roll) as the ring closes on the dancer who plays it. Chain patterns, build flow and keep the ball moving. Nobody wins or loses; the aim is a beautiful dance.
howToPlay: Watch the ring close on the dancer who is about to touch the ball.
Tap the matching pad just before it closes: foot, knee, heel, neck or shoulder.
Perfect timing fills the flow bar and raises your score multiplier.
Land the touches of a named pattern in a row for a bonus.
Dance four rounds; harmony earns up to five stars and new courtyards.
